point_rating <- function(games) {
  players <- sort(unique(c(games$White, games$Black)))
  idx     <- setNames(seq_along(players), players)
  pts     <- numeric(length(players))
  gp      <- numeric(length(players))

  wi <- idx[as.character(games$White)]
  bi <- idx[as.character(games$Black)]
  sc <- games$Score

  # vectorized accumulation (fast; no explicit per-row R loop)
  pts <- as.numeric(tapply(c(sc, 1 - sc), c(wi, bi), sum, default = 0))
  gp  <- as.numeric(table(factor(c(wi, bi), levels = seq_along(players))))

  data.frame(player = players, points = pts, games = gp)
}

pr <- point_rating(games)
summary(pr$points)
